info.title: SingIt Ask
info.description: Language-model answers paid per answer over x402 in USDC on Base or Solana. No accounts or API keys. Free to try: model free/deepseek-v4.1-flash, 20 answers a day, no payment.
info.x-guidance: POST JSON in OpenAI chat-completions format to the paths below. A first request without payment returns 402 with the challenge in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; sign an x402 v2 "exact" or "upto" USDC authorization on Base or Solana and retry the same request with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. List callable models at GET /v1/models and free (unpaid) prices at GET /v1/prices. Nothing is charged unless an answer comes back.

post.summary: Generate an answer from a language model
post.description: Ask a language model without an API key: any model listed at GET /v1/models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen and more; default deepseek-v4.1-flash). OpenAI chat-completions request. Pays actual token cost + 30% + a settlement fee (0.001 USDC on Base, 0.002 on Solana), up to a ceiling that follows the model's price; nothing is charged without an answer. Exact payers instead pay a flat price for a typical-length answer. Models prefixed free/ (free/deepseek-v4.1-flash) answer with no payment, within 20 answers a day per network, 400 tokens and 4000 characters each.

content.description: Plain text; all messages together under 24000 characters.

max_tokens.description: The longest answer, in tokens. The payment ceiling grows with it; the charge follows what was used.

model.description: Any model id from GET /v1/models; the ceiling follows its price. Omit for the default model. Free to try, no payment: free/deepseek-v4.1-flash.

messages.content: Where is good coffee near the Colosseum?
